name: SAM2 predicted-mask to stored-memory regional assignment alignment
question: Do Run 123's regional memberships from each frame's saved low-resolution predicted-mask logits agree with memberships derived from the exact probability map passed to SAM2's memory encoder for that same frame?

SAM2.implementation: SAM2Base._encode_new_memory passes sigmoid-transformed high-resolution predicted-mask logits to MemoryEncoder; MemoryEncoder.MaskDownSampler downsamples the mask with total stride 16 to the 64x64 memory-token grid.

soft_region_partition.reuse: Apply the same continuous mean/within-cell-variance partition at each source resolution: 4x4 cells on stored 256x256 logits and 16x16 cells on the actual 1024x1024 memory-encoder input.

data.frames: every prompt and post-prompt frame that has a stored SAM2 memory feature

capture.memory_input: Capture the exact mask probability tensor passed to SAM2 MemoryEncoder on each frame.
capture.saved_prediction: Read that frame's own stored pred_masks from SAM2 output_dict; do not reconstruct or use a later exported mask.
capture.inference: Native SAM2 propagation only; hooks are read-only and do not change the returned values.

interpretation.pass: Near-identical memberships across all stored frames. Freeze the current region-assignment route only if supported by the measured agreement.
interpretation.fail: Treat Run 123 as testing a mismatched region map; derive memberships from the actual memory-encoder mask and rerun every affected regional experiment. Do not alter the original results.
